scope: Synthetic native-eye render target sampling on real Quest Vulkan; not whole-scene GLES parity, live XR, gameplay or performance
checks: All bytes of separate eye copies equal their own native source
Two-stage register combiner samples correct eye
Self-feedback uses snapshot before overwriting each eye
Dominant world projection retained when presented auxiliary target has unrelated cached projection
Interior aliases and pitch reinterpretation return unsupported without guest fallback
implemented_formats: Exact linear ARGB8888/RGB565 bindings; new native RT fixture tests ARGB8888
limits: Guest CPU edits to stereo host targets need explicit coherence handling
No gameplay regression coverage or performance claim
